pages.text: Each NPC storyline can be completed once per player. Finding another copy of that NPC or an unrepaired home does not start a second reward run. Your personal story history follows you across those copies.

The building itself belongs to the world: everyone nearby can see its repairs. Deliveries restore parts of the nearby home in stages. Existing repairs or player alterations can mean a delivery produces no visible change. A repaired building alone does not prove that you personally completed the storyline.
FTB quest progress may be shared with your team. That shared tracker is separate from each player’s NPC history and personal completion advancement. In solo play, the same one-time story rules apply.
